vision: The return leg stops feeling like a long autopilot jog and becomes a tense, readable escape sequence: once the sanctum is attuned, a deterministic anomaly front advances from behind, forcing purposeful movement while preserving fair, completable runs.
objectives: Introduce an epilogue pressure mechanic (anomaly pursuit) that materially changes return-leg decision-making instead of relying on timer text alone.
Add clear world/HUD feedback for pressure state (hazard proximity, warning tiers, and contact penalties) so urgency is both visible and actionable.
Expose additive bridge/objective telemetry for pressure mechanics (hazard active/proximity/contacts/warnings) without breaking existing OBS consumers.
Upgrade pilgrimage playtest behavior to validate pressure-state signals and fail on unsafe regressions (return_failed, repeated hazard contacts, missing pressure telemetry).
Keep deterministic completion quality across seeded runs while ensuring at least one meaningful pressure warning appears during normal epilogue flow.
implementationHints: Treat this as gameplay tension + readability polish, not just a timer tweak: players should feel chased, not merely timed.
Keep hazard behavior deterministic and seed-stable so executor/playtester evidence remains reproducible.
Use additive fields/events for compatibility with existing automation and dashboards.
implementationDetails: In src/main.js, add a dedicated epilogue pressure runtime (for example anomalyFront) that activates on return_started and deactivates on return_completed/return_failed/reset.

Author a visible anomaly actor/effect (mesh + light/fog pulse + route-aware positioning) that advances from the sanctum toward the player/return lane at deterministic speed; it should be readable from third-person camera without obscuring objective markers.

Define hazard proximity bands (safe/warning/critical/contact) and emit bridge events such as return_pressure_warning, return_pressure_critical, and return_pressure_contact with objectiveId, hazardDist, and returnTimeRemainingSec.
Apply fair, non-random contact consequences (for example short movement slow, timer penalty, or lock reset) with cooldown to avoid infinite stun loops; log applied penalty values in events.
Update epilogue HUD/objective HUD copy to include live pressure state (distance/critical status) so manual players can react without reading console logs.

Extend objective snapshot payload additively with fields like pressureActive, pressureLevel, pressureDist, pressureContacts, pressurePenaltySecTotal, and pressureWarningsTriggered while preserving existing keys.

Update scripts/playtest-beacon-pilgrimage.mjs so the controller recognizes pressure telemetry and biases movement away from imminent contact (while still pursuing objective), then fails loudly if pressure fields are missing, return_failed fires, or pressure contact count exceeds configured threshold.

Add log metrics for epilogue pressure quality (for example min_pressure_dist, pressure_warning_count, pressure_contact_count, pressure_penalty_sec_total) alongside existing startup/lock/cycle metrics.

Validation before handoff: npm run build; seeded runs ROAM_SEED=404/505/606 with AGENT_SCRIPT=scripts/playtest-beacon-pilgrimage.mjs and RUN_SEC long enough for full cycle under pressure; one screenshot-enabled isolated-port run proving hazard readability and non-blank captures.

Record evidence in sim/cycles/<cycleId>/exec_result.json and playtest_handoff.txt: exact commands, pressure telemetry/events observed, penalty behavior, pass/fail thresholds used, and screenshot paths.
